description: Source code for the Opencart System Library Cache APCU class, implementing caching operations using APC User Cache (APCU) in PHP.

classes.name: Apcu
classes.description: A class that provides caching functionalities using PHP's APCU extension, including get, set, delete, and flush methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with an optional expiration time and checks if APCU functions are available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key if cache is active.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache under the specified key with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by key.
